primary.name: loop
primary.description: Follow the local triad loopback protocol for Codex, OpenCode, and CCGLM/freeglm. Use when a message contains $loop, /loop, TRIAD_LOOPBACK_V1, or asks agents to report to the next agent until the task is closed.
